name: Sprynt
tagline: A bot that joins incident calls, transcribes with speakers, tracks action items and answers when called.

awards: MLH || Best Use of Auth0 || Wireless Headphones

problem: Incident calls lose track of who owns what.
solution: Transcribes in real time with speaker labels, pulls action items to a live board, catches verbal reassignments and responds by chat and voice when addressed.
demo_moment: Team-described: say 'give that to Sarah' and see the board update.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH || Best Use of Auth0 || Wireless Headphones” among 231 submissions.
From the team's internship incident calls.

lessons: Catching a spoken reassignment is the magic moment.
